sources.title: The Smoky Collection - a Hugging Face Space by Nanite-Labs
sources.snippet: The Chat Model: nanites-smoky-1b-chat The chat model is the language side of the collection. It's a Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct fine-tuned to answer as an old Smoky Mountain resident of the 1930s — a voice persona, not a Hall speaker.
